title: FDR on financial interests owning America

tellings.quote: And he he said to in a in a conversation or letter that he wrote that the financial interests had owned America since the time of Andrew Jackson.

plain: Franklin D. Roosevelt, the American president of the 1930s, is said to have written that financial interests had owned America since the days of Andrew Jackson, a president of a century earlier. The researcher Jason Simosa brings this up on the show. He says it came from "a conversation or letter" Roosevelt wrote, without naming the document or its date, and offers it as a hint that hidden money has long steered the country.
